acceptanceCriteria: The decision 0158 row for developer checks no longer claims internal/dogfoodflow/check.go uses ordinary Git status, or it is amended with a dated note that DCW-V0-045 moved check.go to Core's hardened probe (gokernel.ProbeRepositoryContext).
The line citation in docs/decisions/0158-local-excludes-remain-status-policy-2026-09-12.md points at the probe call and make line-citations-check passes.
body: Observed while landing V1-1279 (dogfood-check declared output change). docs/decisions/0158-local-excludes-remain-status-policy-2026-09-12.md line 46 ('Developer checks and measurement tools') cites internal/dogfoodflow/check.go and states the dogfood check uses ordinary Git status, so local/global ignores can hide untracked drift. Since DCW-V0-045 the check reads status through Core's hardened probe, gokernel.ProbeRepositoryContext (internal/dogfoodflow/check.go:248-251 on origin/main 1f35e3da7 plus V1-1279), which refuses repository-owned filters and hooks. The claim was already stale before V1-1279; V1-1279 only re-pinned the citation (now check.go:157) to keep line-citations-check green with the same cited content. Expected: the decision records the actual status source for check.go. Actual: it records ordinary Git status. Version: corvint origin/main 1f35e3da7e8b0dee971d280a7feb52c52ae2ef78. Suspected defect in a decision record, not in runtime behaviour.
title: Decision 0158 still says dogfoodflow check.go uses ordinary Git status (stale since DCW-V0-045)
